title: MLX arctan: finite weighted derivatives collapse to zero after intermediate overflow
author: Xamit Kadirbekov
summary: In Apple MLX CPU float32, arctan differentiation forms 1+x² before division. For finite x=-2^64 and seed=-2^120, x² overflows and the JVP/VJP becomes signed zero although the correctly rounded result is -0.00390625. A scale-aware research candidate reduces 352 discrepancies per tested layout to zero, with documented higher-order residuals.
